shortDescription: Retrieve DNS rewrite rules from AdGuardHome

options.name: host
options.description: URL of AdGuardHome host. For example, V(https://my-adguard.my-domain) or V(http://192.168.1.2).

options.name: password
options.description: Related password for the AdGuardHome user.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Ability to disable TLS certificate validation. This should only set to V(false) when the network path between the host the module is run on and the AdGuard host is fully under your control and trusted.
